fields.acceptance: Unit tests in internal/run (and internal/api where the step runner builds the env) show a command, a wait and an agent step each get GOTMPDIR=<git common dir>/rhiza/runs/<run id>/gotmp, the folder exists when the step's process starts, and it is gone after the run finishes, fails or is abandoned; go test -trimpath ./internal/run/... ./internal/api/... -run for those tests passes
fields.statement: Every process a run starts (command, wait and agent steps) runs with GOTMPDIR set to the run's own folder <git common dir>/rhiza/runs/<run id>/gotmp, created when a step starts and removed when the run ends, so no sweep of the shared TMPDIR can remove a live go build's $WORK

fields.acceptance: A table test of the pure signature match accepts the 'could not import io (open $WORK/b033/_pkg_.a: no such file or directory)' and "can't create $WORK/b094/_pkg_.a: open $WORK/b094/_pkg_.a: no such file or directory" lines and rejects other failures (a compile error, a missing file outside $WORK); a stepRunner.Command test in internal/api with a command that fails with the signature once then passes returns exit 0 after one rerun and one stderr line, one that fails with it twice returns the second failure, and one that fails otherwise is not rerun
fields.statement: A command step that exits non-zero with go's vanished-$WORK signature (open $WORK/<bNNN>/...: no such file or directory) is rerun once by the step runner, which writes one stderr line saying so, and the second result stands
